data.name: Jamir
data.gender_notes: Jamir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jamir is derived from the Arabic word 'jamara' which means 'to gather' or 'sustainer'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong, powerful, and capable of providing for their families and community. The name Jamir carries the meaning “Gatherer, Sustainer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Jamir usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer, sustainer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and strength of God, and the role of the individual in sustaining and nurturing their loved ones and community.
data.etymology: Jamir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer, Sustainer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamir total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It is also considered a name that is rich in spiritual significance and is often associated with the qualities of being virtuous and pious.
